name: Spirit of the mansion
source:
In the "cursed twins" route, she is the original owner of the mansion.

A woman of authority in Bourgogne. In 1800, she gave birth to twin daughters, who eventually murdered her for the title. She cursed the mansion and all of its inhabitants, manifesting as a green cat.
